nativeAdaptation.callbackBoundary: Native subprocess requests are deadline-bounded JSON-RPC calls, while the pure Rust callback adapter executes the same return normalization and containment contract without a JavaScript promise runtime.
nativeAdaptation.identity: Arc pointer identity preserves Hunk registration and registry authority across Ratatui runtime replacement.
